Argument.Label: SMTP Ser&ver(s)
Argument.Description: The SMTP server that will be asked to send the email. Several servers can be defined, separated by a comma. If empty, the value is read from the ETLForge server configuration file. If the mail server uses a non-default port you can append ":port" to the smtp server name.

Argument.Label: &Account
Argument.Description: The name of the SMTP account. If empty, the value is read from the ETLForge server configuration file.

Argument.Label: &Password
Argument.Description: The SMTP account's password. If empty, the value is read from the ETLForge server configuration file.

Argument.Label: &CC
Argument.Description: A comma-separated list of CC recipients.

Argument.Label: &BCC
Argument.Description: A comma-separated list of BCC recipients.

Argument.Label: &Reply-To
Argument.Description: The reply-to address. The From address is used if this field is empty.

Argument.Label: &UseSSL
Argument.Description: Boolean flag for SSL/TLS encryption use.
